macros.name: entity
macros.doc: Inside {tikzpicture} this is an abbreviation for \node[entity].

macros.name: ormbf
macros.doc: Sets the font to a bold variant of \ormtext .

macros.name: ormbraces
macros.doc: The commands \ormbraces and \ormvalues are handy abbreviations to create curly brackets.

macros.name: ormc
macros.doc: Sets the font to a \ormtext in constraint color.

macros.name: ormleft
macros.doc: To show the inverse reading, add an arrow tip with the commands \ormleft or \ormup .

macros.name: ormsub
macros.doc: Puts some text in a subscript variant of \ormtext .

macros.name: ormsup
macros.doc: Puts some text in a superscript variant of \ormtext .

macros.name: ormtext
macros.doc: Sets the font to the same sans-serif variant which is used in ORM diagrams.

macros.name: ormup
macros.doc: To show the inverse reading, add an arrow tip with the commands \ormleft or \ormup .

macros.name: ormvalues
macros.doc: Puts some text as \ormc in braces in constraint color.

macros.name: rules
macros.doc: This command is an abbreviation for \matrix[row sep=0mm,nodes={right}] inside {tikzpicture}.
